However, Adilla has sinister plans for the vulnerable pupas, leading to a desperate fight to save them from her clutches.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. But the wacky problems don't stop there! When a ghost crashes playtime, Arpo has to use all his tech to bust it. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she heads to Skyzone to explore the science of bouncing! First, she has a big question... how does someone do a flip? She gets some instruction from an amazing jumper, plays on the trampolines and even learns some numbers. Then, she's off on a solo adventure to answer the question, 'how does bouncing work?' She experiments with different kinds of balls to see which bounces best and even discovers the science behind trampolines!

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: VeeFriends
programme.desc: The VeeFriends are ready for some friendly competition! The action starts with an exciting egg and spoon race that tests everyone's balance and speed. The challenges continue with an intense staring contest, a hilarious water balloon fight, and a strategic game of hide-and-seek. From bubble-blowing contests to seeing who can be the quietest, it's a day packed with fun-filled battles where the only goal is to have a great time with friends.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is exploring some mighty machines at work! First, he visits a construction yard to learn all about skid steers. He explores all the parts of the skid steer, inside and out, while learning how they work and how they're used. Then, Blippi takes you for a ride inside a real forklift! He learns about these amazing construction trucks as he explores all their different parts before trying his hand at lifting something with the forklift himself!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi goes on a pizza pie adventure, shopping for ingredients, making dough from scratch and cooking his own cheesy, handmade pizza!

programme.title: Oddbods

Then, a rogue bear enters Oddsville and the park ranger's tranquilizer darts accidentally hit Zee! It's up to the Oddbods to watch over his sleepwalking antics. Finally, after a moment of humiliation, Pogo and Jeff get into a competitive battle to see who the better clown is.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in for some big surprises! Newt discovers a treasure map that leads to a valuable find, but it's buried under Jeff's pristine lawn! A battle of wits begins! Then, Jeff's prize marrow comes to life thanks to some radioactive waste! Finally, after a night of gorging on Bubbles' vegetable patch, Zee wakes up to discover that he's grown into a giant overnight! Trapped inside his house, the others must work to find an antidote.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some new problems! Pogo finally meets his match when he annoys an equally annoying and determined bird species called a 'Twitcher.' Then, when a highly infectious fever hits the cul-de-sac, Zee finds himself playing nurse to all his friends, who display a variety of extreme symptoms. Finally, Jeff accidentally causes Pogo to crash-land, causing him to lose his memory, and Jeff decides to rehabilitate him.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle may be small, but they're tiny heroes on giant-sized adventures! When a hamster gets stuck in a colorful cardboard maze, a rescue mission begins! programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready to welcome some new Magic Pets with Mila and Morphle! Then, they meet Slushyseal, who can change items into juice pops, but the friends have to stop him when he starts turning all the trees and flowers into frozen treats! From a pet that swaps bodies to one that hypnotizes animals, it's a day full of new and magical friends!

programme.title: Blippi

programme.title: Blippi

programme.title: Blippi

So Blippi learns all about light and electricity. He goes through tunnels, plays both giant and regular pianos and even makes a shadow puppet show with his hands!

Fuse and Newt must work together to rehabilitate their friend back to normality.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a very busy day! Zee needs some money, so he does some odd jobs, but his laziness makes him a less-than-ideal employee. programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for some fun snowy day adventures! First, he heads to Leavenworth Ski Hill for some learning fun in the snow. He learns all about numbers, colors and shapes while exploring. During his visit, he also learns all about cool winter vehicles like snowmobiles! The snowy adventure ends with a festive visit to a Reindeer Farm, where Blippi learns all about the beautiful animals that make Christmas so special.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she explores the amazing Kennedy Space Center! Her adventure begins as she learns about rockets, space shuttles and the scientific discovery of space. She gets to see the famous spacecraft Atlantis and sit in a model of a flight deck! Then, it's time to blast off as Meekah goes on her very own virtual Mars Mission! She learns about the international space station, does a space walk and goes on a simulated trip to Mars!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods have some new goals! After a sequence of annoying events, Jeff decides he's had enough and is moving out! The others rally together to convince him to stay. Then, Fuse and Slick are smitten with a female jogger who blows them both a kiss. The pair are determined to outshine one another to prove who the kiss was for. Finally, Zee enters a road endurance race to win a trophy that looks like a gigantic hot dog!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are in a real panic! First, Fuse and Pogo find themselves stranded inside Jeff's house after he goes on holiday. They must find a way to get along until Jeff gets back! Then, Fuse is rescued by Newt from an embarrassing situation and takes it upon himself to repay the debt by becoming her hero. Finally, one of Bubbles' experiments ends up in Pogo's ice cream, and his customers start to experience terrible side effects!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions and robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo and his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, and a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him and Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a guide to staying healthy and happy! The learning starts with hygiene, as JJ and his friends learn the importance of washing their hands and how to scrub-a-dub-dub in the bath. Then, it's time for some big milestones! Sing along as JJ learns to use the potty and TomTom learns what happens when you lose a tooth. Plus, join the Melon Patch kids as they visit the doctor for a checkup and learn that it's nothing to be afraid of!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun day at Billy Beez indoor playground with Meekah! She is visiting a playground that Blippi loves to visit, and as it's her first time, Blippi has left surprise items in her jam pack for her to play with! Meekah just needs to find where they fit best. While visiting, she also plays in Honeycomb Village, where she realizes that there are many occupations needed for a town to run smoothly!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi zips around Ferrari World! He enjoys remote control challenges and builds his driving skills on roller coasters and F1 simulators.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for Blippi's ultimate playdates! Join Blippi and his friend Navaeh as they make wacky pizzas with fun ingredients like cheese and candy. The adventure continues as Blippi and Mael go on a dino egg hunt, digging through a ball pit to find all the missing eggs. Then, it's time for a colorful dance party, learning colors by jumping on a grid. Finally, they dress up as firefighters to save a dino stuffy in an exciting rescue game.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Get ready for epic rescues and Mr. Weasel's hilarious fails! The chaos begins when Weasel fills Max the Monster Truck's tires with helium, causing him to float away and forcing Gecko to perform a sky-high rescue! Then, Weasel's plan to give Molly extra bouncy springs goes wrong, and Gecko has to help her stop bouncing. The rescues continue when Weasel's new electro-magnet sucks up Baby Truck and the Mechanicals, and Gecko has to save the day!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles and needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: VeeFriends
programme.desc: The VeeFriends are ready for some friendly competition! The action starts with an exciting egg and spoon race that tests everyone's balance and speed. The challenges continue with an intense staring contest, a hilarious water balloon fight, and a strategic game of hide-and-seek. From bubble-blowing contests to seeing who can be the quietest, it's a day packed with fun-filled battles where the only goal is to have a great time with friends.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for some vroom vroom working vehicles! Blippi wants to build a playground, but his toy bulldozer is too small. He learns that there are giant construction vehicles that can get the job done. Then, Firefighter Blippi visits a fire station to learn all about firetrucks and how they help the community.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's time for Meekah to get crafty with some DIY and design! First, she visits the Nailed It! DIY Studio where she flexes her crafting skills and creates her own project. Meekah learns to nail wood together, sand it down smooth and then paint it with a roller and stencils! Then, she visits Playday where she gets creative and learns about her personal style and basic fashion design. She designs an 'M' for her shirt and crafts a new accessory!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Willow starts acting secretive and skipping her duties, the rest of the team gets worried and hires a detective to spy on her. Their investigation leads to a shocking revelation: Willow has been secretly mentoring their friend Chowser through his amazing transformation into a butterfly! The team must quickly adapt to Chowser's new, winged form as they work together on their latest mission to save a group of ants.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: Syd takes on a new role as the backyard mail carrier, but his haste leads to a series of comical package mix-ups that accidentally l and him three dates on the same night! While Syd juggles his romantic predicament, the rest of the team faces a crisis of their own. They find a key Shrinkinator part, but at the same moment, Willow and Syd's bionics begin to dangerously malfunction, forcing them to choose between the mission and their own safety.

programme.title: Supa Strikas
programme.desc: Journey through the world of soccer like you have never seen before! Supa Strikas' quest for Super League glory takes them everywhere and anywhere you can imagine. Their skills and determination get them out of the trickiest of situations.

Fuse goes to extreme lengths to find his bear. Finally, Fuse accidentally breaks Bubbles' totem pole and tries to cover it up.

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are getting into trouble! Slick sees Bubbles' talent for invention and decides he wants in on it, too. But after several failures, he takes a shortcut and 'borrows' one of her ideas, to disastrous effect! Then, Pogo makes himself homeless while playing a reckless game and is kindly taken in by Fuse. But it's not long before his prank-playing becomes insufferable. Plus, Bubbles discovers a possibly cursed ancient artifact.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are on the case in the ultimate dino detective mystery! Park Ranger Tara is close to completing her dino guidebook but needs a scan of a T-Rex to finish it. Then, Park Rangers Asher and Darren discover mysterious dino footprints in the ground and decide to follow the trail on an exciting adventure. Finally, Park Ranger Zoe discovers a theory about a Flying T-Rex, and the rangers set out to prove if this incredible dinosaur truly exists!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun scavenger hunt with the Park Rangers! First, Park Rangers Maddie and Zoey find that all their gear has vanished. As they search for clues to solve the mystery, they stumble upon a mysterious surprise box! Then, the Gadget Wizard has hidden all the T-Rex Ranch dinosaurs! The Park Rangers are on a scavenger hunt to recover them, solving clues and overcoming challenges to find and return the missing dinosaurs!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super silly day of ranger fails! First, Park Ranger Darren accidentally gets his night vision goggles stuck on his head, leaving him unable to see properly. Park Ranger Asher has to step up to be Darren's eyes and ears to guide him! Then, in another silly mishap, Darren accidentally gets hit with a sleepy dart! Can Park Rangers Asher and Naomi find the ingredients for the Wake Up Juice in time?

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10

This energetic compilation features Blippi learning new sports, exploring amazing playgrounds, and discovering all sorts of fun ways to play. It's a celebration of being active, learning new skills, and having a great time.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi has so many buddies that he loves! There's Meekah, and TABBS, and DBO and all of the friends he meets on his adventures. Blippi invites his buddies at home to join him in remembering some of his favorite moments spent with friends. Awwww!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for an action-packed day of battling evil robots and racing villains! First, the new and improved Robofreeze becomes faulty, and Mila and Morphle must help Officer Freeze retrieve the remote to turn him off! Then, it's time for the Pet Port Rally, but naughty Winston cheats by using sneaky devices to slow everyone down. The chaos continues as two Robofreezes turn evil and multiply, and a lightning strike turns another one into a super-powered menace!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Watch out, because these cute creatures are causing big chaos! First, Chroma the Magic Pet has a cold, and every time she sneezes, she causes a huge color splat! Mila and Morphle must find her before the whole city is covered in color. Then, the Baby Morphles arrive from another dimension and they are in the mood for a game of chase! From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo is dealing with squirrel trouble and other wacky problems! That pesky squirrel is always trying to steal food or run off with Baby Daniel's teddy bear. Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire, like when a toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably and when Baby Daniel accidentally terrorizes him with a magnet. It's a day of very wacky problems!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.desc: Munirah menjumpai sebuah nota cinta di dalam sebuah buku yang diperolehi secara rambang dari 'blind date with a book' dan cuba untuk menemukan pasangan di dalam nota tersebut yang merubah hidup Munirah.

programme.title: Bukan Cerita Cinta Cliche
programme.desc: Seorang penulis skrip kisah-kisah cinta tetapi masih bersendirian mengimpikan cinta dalam kehidupan realitinya, lalu dia menyertai sebuah kumpulan terapi untuk berkongsi masalah peribadinya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Then, the family acts out the story of Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall. The animal fun continues as Baby John spends the day at the aquarium and runs into Baby Shark! He learns the 'Baby Shark' dance and has an exciting dance marathon! Plus, the family dresses up like little dinosaurs!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join Mia and Max for a big day of fun and learning! First, they go on a lovely little train ride with Tootson and their special friend Twinkle to learn all about shapes. Then, they hop on the Big Red Bus with Daddy, moving their hands like wheels going 'round and wipers going 'swish'! The learning continues as they have a musical drumming session with saucepans, play a game of 'What's In The Bag?' and learn about the world around them while singing and dancing.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Get ready for a big day of imagination and play with Mia and Max! First, they decide to let their imagination run free and build a big dollhouse, but Max has more fun pretending to be a dinosaur that knocks it down! Then, Daddy and Twinkle show the kids how much fun can be had with shadow puppets, making all sorts of different animal shapes. The imaginative fun continues as they turn five empty green bottles into fuzzy-armed monsters that Twinkle brings to life!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join Twinkle the star for her most magical moments! When Max, Muffin and Bao Bao build a toy train, Twinkle transforms into a real train and takes the kids on a ride all around the house! Then, when Max pretends he's a wizard, Twinkle turns into a magic wand to make his magic real! Her powers continue as she brings fruits and veggies to life for a puppet show and turns into a giant wibbly-wobbly jelly for everyone to play on! It's always magical with Twinkle!

programme.title: Nina's Familia
programme.desc: Spend a fun-filled day with Nina and her amazing family! First, Nina and her siblings learn all about how things fly as they dream of soaring through the sky like their dad, who is a pilot! Then, it's time for a yummy adventure in the kitchen as Nina and her Abuelita (grandma) decide to make a traditional Mexican breakfast for everyone. The family fun continues as they go on a scavenger hunt for colorful flowers and work together to help the magical Star Star get back into the sky!

programme.title: CoComelon Classroom
programme.desc: Join Ms. Appleberry and JJ as they meet the classroom goldfish, Flip, Flop and learn about shapes. Help an alligator learn to brush her teeth, quack and count like ducks then explore the letter G. Discover opposites like big and small with help from the Melon Learning Box and sing along to fun songs.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for some fun learning adventures at home! First, TomTom leads his lab assistants JJ and YoYo in some amazing science experiments, from making slime to building an erupting volcano! Then, it's time to head to the kitchen, where YoYo teaches JJ how to make the perfect peanut butter and jelly sandwich. The at-home fun continues as the kids discover a cassette player and record all the cool sounds they hear around the house!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on a big world adventure! First, he and his friends explore the reptile zoo to learn all about the scaly creatures. Then, it's time to learn about bugs at the insect park! The adventure gets out of this world as Jack, Jill and Baby John explore a new adventure: space camp! They learn how to be an astronaut and visit other planets as they fly a rocket ship and train in zero gravity!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for some imagination and problem-solving fun! Oh no, Teddy is missing! But don't worry, Mom, Dad, Jack and Jill are all there to help Baby John search for him and solve the mystery. Then, dressed as pigs, Baby John, Jack and Jill use their imagination to re-enact the classic 'Three Little Pigs' story, with Dad playing the Big Bad Wolf! The problem-solving continues as the family helps guide Jill through the experience of losing her first tooth.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John on some big day out adventures! First, the family visits the zoo to see all the amazing animals, like elephants, monkeys and hippos! Then, it's Baby John's first time at the water park, where he has lots of fun with water squirters and wading pools. The adventure continues with a trip to a fun theme park, where the family enjoys the merry-go-round, bumper cars and yummy cotton candy!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for adventure as Arpo's imagination runs wild! After a bump on the head, Arpo is convinced he's a pirate, leading the family on a swashbuckling adventure for treasure. Then, Arpo builds an epic backyard rollercoaster for Daniel, but it's up to Totbot to save the day when it goes out of control! The fantasy continues when Arpo accidentally creates a giant, sentient jelly monster that takes over the entire house and needs to be stopped!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle may be small, but they're tiny heroes on giant-sized adventures! When a hamster gets stuck in a colorful cardboard maze, a rescue mission begins! Mila and Morphle get shrunk to hamster size and go into the maze to find their little furry pal. Then, when a whale gets stranded on the beach, the friends shrink it to get it back to the ocean. But when Winston races away with the tiny whale, the chase is on!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Watch out, because these cute creatures are causing big chaos! First, Chroma the Magic Pet has a cold, and every time she sneezes, she causes a huge color splat! Mila and Morphle must find her before the whole city is covered in color. Then, the Baby Morphles arrive from another dimension and they are in the mood for a game of chase! From a giant living doll to a runaway magic pet, these cute creatures are causing chaos everywhere!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are turning little problems into big adventures! When Mr. Vanderboos accidentally sprays hair growth serum on Daddy, Officer Freeze mistakes him for a hairy monster, and a wild chase begins! Then, Mila has a bad cold, but she still has to help Morphle figure out the right morphs to rescue a dog stuck in a tree. From playing a quiet game to avoid waking a napping neighbor to playing hide and seek with friends, every little problem is a big adventure!

programme.title: Little Angel

Then, the kids get a special lesson in culture as Kwame introduces them to African instruments like the Balafon and Sangba drum. The day continues with Cody helping his dad cook delicious dishes from Ghana and ends with Mom and Dad comforting him after a bad dream.

programme.title: Nina's Familia
programme.desc: Spend a fun-filled day with Nina and her amazing family! First, Nina and her siblings learn all about how things fly as they dream of soaring through the sky like their dad, who is a pilot! Then, it's time for a yummy adventure in the kitchen as Nina and her Abuelita (grandma) decide to make a traditional Mexican breakfast for everyone. The family fun continues as they go on a scavenger hunt for colorful flowers and work together to help the magical Star Star get back into the sky!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: JJ is learning all about how to share, help and be kind! First, he learns the magic words 'please' and 'thank you,' and what to do when you make a mistake. The lessons continue as JJ, YoYo and TomTom show how much fun it is to share their snacks and toys. Being kind also means being helpful, and JJ's family loves to help each other around the house. From using good manners at the table to learning how to wait in line, it's a day of learning to be a good friend and family member!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's a day of funny feelings and creative fixes! A worried Dandy brings Fiona to the garage because her lights and sirens aren't working. Gecko discovers no fix is needed because Fiona is just feeling sad inside. Then, when Blue is anxious about school because Bobby doesn't look like the bus in his book, Gecko comes up with a creative plan to let the Mechs paint Bobby! Plus, Gecko finds a creative way to deal with a swarm of bees that have nested in Trevor's engine.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko on his biggest adventures yet, from waterfalls to outer space! First, when Grandma's caravan rolls into a river and heads for a waterfall, Gecko must perform a daring chase to save her! Then, a lovely day at the beach becomes perilous when some vehicles get caught in the tide, requiring a helicopter rescue. The adventure blasts off as the Mechs accidentally launch their homemade spaceship to the moon and need to use solar power to get home!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Gecko is busy stopping Mr. Weasel's wacky schemes! First, Gecko and Weasel face off in a football match, but Weasel starts cheating! Gecko must fix his damaged teammates and teach Weasel a lesson. Then, Bobby the Bus's battery goes missing, and all clues point to Weasel! The schemes continue as Weasel tries to show off at a 'fix up fair' but needs rescuing, and he steals cakes from a bake sale but ends up crashing!

programme.title: CeCe Time
programme.desc: It's CeCe Time, full of kittens, tutus and fun! The big day arrives when CeCe gets her very own adorable kitten! She loves her new friend and wants to put on a show, so she gets in her ballerina outfit to dance for her kitty. Then, after hosting many tea parties for her stuffed animals, CeCe invites her real friends JJ and Bella over for a high tea party! From ice skating with Mom to imagining stick ponies are unicorns, it's always a fun and graceful day with CeCe!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: It's a learning dance party with JJ's animal pals! First, learn all about vowels with the fun and silly song 'Apples and Bananas.' Then, get ready to count as you dance with dinosaurs and countdown from five to one. The learning continues as you guess what sounds different animals make and bounce like rabbits, frogs and kangaroos on a trampoline! Plus, you can even learn to sing 'Itsy Bitsy Spider' entirely in Spanish with Nina!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's time to learn the fundamentals with JJ! Join him and his friends as they practice their numbers by counting baby chicks with Grandpa and singing about five little monkeys jumping on the bed. Then, it's time to learn about colors! Watch as the kids paint plain toy cars with a splash of color and help Ms. Appleberry mix primary colors with jello to make secondary colors. From learning shapes to making yummy rainbow popsicles, this adventure is full of learning fun!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John thinks his family members are the best heroes! He really loves and admires his dad, and wants to copy everything he does to be just like him. His big brother Jack is a hero, too, and is always willing to help his little brother and teach him new things. After Mom's cupcakes go missing, Baby John dresses up as a police officer to find out who took them, interviewing each of his family member heroes!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for some imagination and problem-solving fun! Oh no, Teddy is missing! But don't worry, Mom, Dad, Jack and Jill are all there to help Baby John search for him and solve the mystery. Then, dressed as pigs, Baby John, Jack and Jill use their imagination to re-enact the classic 'Three Little Pigs' story, with Dad playing the Big Bad Wolf! The problem-solving continues as the family helps guide Jill through the experience of losing her first tooth.

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John is meeting our amazing local heroes! He discovers the important role of a police officer in the community and learns that they are here to help keep everyone safe. Then, he gets inspired by firefighters and forms his very own rescue team! The heroic day continues as the kids learn about all different kinds of jobs on career day at preschool and Baby John decides to take on a new challenge: becoming an ambulance driver!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join Mia and Max for a big day of fun and learning! First, they go on a lovely little train ride with Tootson and their special friend Twinkle to learn all about shapes. Then, they hop on the Big Red Bus with Daddy, moving their hands like wheels going 'round and wipers going 'swish'! The learning continues as they have a musical drumming session with saucepans, play a game of 'What's In The Bag?' and learn about the world around them while singing and dancing.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Join the kids for a day of food, play and learning! First, Grandma Panda bakes some cupcakes while Mia and Bari role-play as bakers in their own pretend kitchen and play a game of pat-a-cake. Then, it's time for a teddy bear's picnic with a whole variety of different tasty treats! The learning continues as Daddy and Twinkle show Max how to say hello with a wave before going into town to wave hello to all their friends. It's a fun-filled, yummy day!

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max and their friends! First, they head to the park for some rolling fun as they play Jack and Jill, rolling down the muddy grass and whizzing down the slide! Then, Max gets his first sippy cup and is so excited to show it off that he starts an impromptu tea party with all his playmates. The day of discovery ends with a rainy day competition to see who can make the biggest puddle splash of all!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: It's time to sing, play and learn with all of JJ's animal pals! The fun begins as JJ hosts a big talent show in the clubhouse where all his friends get to showcase their unique skills, from magic to circus tricks! Then, everyone joins in for a fun game of 'Follow the Leader,' where JJ learns that a little encouragement goes a long way. Plus, sing along as the friends learn all the different sounds the animals make and help Humpty Dumpty when he keeps falling off a wall!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's the ultimate pretend play day with JJ! When the cookies go missing, it's up to Detective JJ and his sidekick Bingo to follow the clues and solve the case. Then, when JJ gets nervous on his first carousel ride, Mom helps him unlock his imagination and he becomes a brave knight on a valiant steed! The pretend play continues as Captain JJ and first mate YoYo set sail on the high seas to find a lost sock. From playing chef to being a Turtle Scout, you can be anything!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as his amazing dreams come to life! First, he dreams he is a fish, complete with a tail and fins! He's scared when he meets a big shark, but soon learns the shark just wants a friend to play with. Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket and blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west and finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: Go Buster
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns how to be a good friend! When a new, shy student named Ash the firetruck joins the school, Buster sees he's all alone and invites him to play. Then, Buster learns another important lesson when he starts to lose a game of snakes and ladders and decides to cheat. From learning that sports aren't all about winning to standing up for his friends during a sleepover, Buster is on his way to being the best friend ever!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate creative challenge with Baby John! He wants to build a snowman, but it's the middle of summer! When he sees Manny playing in the mud, he has a great idea to build a mudman instead! Then, the boys work together to make muffins, but they get a little too carried away and make a big mess in the kitchen. The creative challenges continue as the boys try to build a London Bridge that won't fall down!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Sing along to Baby John's favorite animal songs! First, the kids welcome a new puppy named Bingo to the family and sing the classic nursery rhyme about him! Then, the family acts out the story of Humpty Dumpty Sat on a Wall. The animal fun continues as Baby John spends the day at the aquarium and runs into Baby Shark! He learns the 'Baby Shark' dance and has an exciting dance marathon! Plus, the family dresses up like little dinosaurs!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Baby John is learning some very important lessons! First, he refuses to try his veggies and fruits, but Mom finds different ways to convince him after she sees that he'll try them if the other members of the family do it first! Then, Mom helps Baby John get through his morning routine with a fun chart. The important lessons continue as Baby John learns about fire safety with a firefighter and how to stay safe during bathtime.

programme.title: Little Baby Bum: Lullabies
programme.desc: Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy
programme.desc: Eps 01 Roz menjalani kehidupan normal sebagai seorang opah setelah pencen dari kerjaya lamanya iaitu ejen perisik. Suatu hari, cucunya Rin, telah menggodam satu permainan komputer dan dia dihubungi oleh seorang misteri dalam talian yang mengetahui identiti Rin. Roz mengesyaki sesuatu tidak kena, tapi malangnya Rin telah diculik oleh penjahat misteri tersebut sebelum Roz sempat bertindak.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Join us at the Dog Rescuers house as host Alan Davies throws the ultimate Christmas party for his doggy friends. This year's Dog Rescuers Christmas Special follows Inspector Lauren Bailey as she journeys to Lapland on an arctic adventure to discover how one winter wonderland dog sled organisation is blazing a trail for the welfare of working Husky Dogs.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: A crazy animal expert raises hundreds of pets in their workplace; the super cute characteristics and breeding secrets of pet turtles are revealed; elementary school students' favorite beetle army attacks, tailor-made insect jelly taste super delicious; and animal therapist is now on duty, "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to visit a parent-child farm and get close to various cute pets.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: An orphaned badger cub puts up a fight when Dr. Matt gets him on the operating table. At Flamingoland, all's not well with a baby giraffe rejected by his mother at birth. Will he be well enough to face a reunion with mum? And back at the surgery, Matt must make a tough decision on Daisy an elderly cat.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc: Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".nnBut they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa. They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive. They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 0.9 meters in size and live over 100 years. But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful. How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Samoyed dogs, known as "smiling angels" are in fact not easy to raise. They require enough love and dedication, especially extraordinary physical strength!!! For you to be happy and healthy with them.nIf you want to raise a Samoyed, or already own one, we hope you can give them the best care and love, and make them your best partners. Come and jot notes of the hard work and tears shared by expert owners :)!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Tempting Tasty Tacos
programme.desc: It’s always taco night at Chef Dale’s house! He turns up the heat with grilled salmon tacos with salsa verde & cauliflower escabeche, duck al pastor tacos with habanero pineapple salsa, & a smokey mushroom queso taco with truffle mole negro.

programme.title: Deluxe Dogs with Crusted Corn & Potatoes
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde puts a modern spin on a classic All-American cookout with his loaded hot dogs, spiced smashed potato salad, chorizo & corn nut crusted corn, and bangin’ banana pudding pops. Sparklers out for this spread!

programme.title: Pasta From Scratch
programme.desc: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce—from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

programme.title: Italian Smokehouse
programme.desc: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

programme.title: Lunch That Goes the Distance
programme.desc: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

programme.title: Getting the Band Back Together
programme.desc: Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic — featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.

programme.title: The Wonderful World of Pizza
programme.desc: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor’s Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They’re pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: Why LA’s "Danger Dog" is the Best Thing You’ll Ever Eat
programme.desc: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You’ll Ever Need
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: One Pot Meals
programme.desc: Any true struggle cook knows there’s nothing better than a one pot dinner. Not only is there hardly any cleanup at the end, but the prep is minimal too, which means hunger satisfaction is imminent. Who says meals can’t be cheap, easy and delicious?

programme.title: Homemade-ish
programme.desc: Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

programme.title: Eat Your Greens
programme.desc: Going green isn’t just a trend; it’s a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie’s colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.

programme.title: Between Two Buns
programme.desc: Is it a burger? Is it a sandwich? Is a burger a sandwich? Not even Frankie knows the answer, but one thing is certain: whatever you want to call them, these fun twists and familiar flavor combos are super satisfying to scarf down.

programme.title: Struggle Splurge
programme.desc: The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour – perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.

programme.desc: Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

programme.title: Lunch That Goes the Distance
programme.desc: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

programme.title: Getting the Band Back Together
programme.desc: Frankie reunites his old band for a jam session and a spin on a college-era classic — featuring Shoyu Ramen with Tare Eggs, sweet and savory Chicken Meatballs, Seaweed Cucumber Salad, and a crispy Okonomiyaki pancake.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor’s Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They’re pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: Why LA’s "Danger Dog" is the Best Thing You’ll Ever Eat
programme.desc: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: Joys of Jamaican Cooking
programme.desc: Stephanie challenges herself to learn more about Caribbean food. Meeting with home cook Kat Williams, who teaches her about Jerk chicken and the art of rice and peas and then restaurant owner Chef Tony who shows her the secret to oxtail.

programme.title: Middle East Street Food Eats
programme.desc: Stephanie highlights the diversity of Middle Eastern cuisine through the lens of street food. Cooking Pakistani kebabs with home chef, Izza Khan, and then learning the complexity of Israeli street food at Dr. Sandwich.

programme.title: Stephanie and the Pitmaster
programme.desc: Stephanie joins UPS driver and home chef, Fernando Carrillo, for a backyard BBQ and a trip to LA institution Carnitas el Momo to learn the subtle art of slow cooking and the techniques of flavor.

programme.title: Legacies and Thai Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ.

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Origins to Originals
programme.desc: From roast chicken to smash burgers to hot sauce, Stephanie Izard meets three different chefs putting their own California-inspired spin on food from their heritage by remixing traditional recipes that center local, fresh ingredients.

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Home Cooking
programme.desc: From a homerun Greek dinner party series to a backyard that’s become a gourmet deli to a Burmese pop up running out of an apartment kitchen, Stephanie Izard meets cooks finding ingenious ways to serve mouth-watering food out of their houses.

programme.title: Forking Delicious: Top 10 Pizza Toppings

programme.title: Forking Delicious: Top 10 Breakfast Dishes
programme.desc: Sweet or savory? Sausage or bacon? These are the eternal debates at the heart of the so-called "most important meal of the day". So rise and shine, because on this episode, our panel is cracking open your top ten breakfast dishes!

programme.title: The Art of Open Fire Cooking
programme.desc: Chef Dale goes back to the roots of cooking, building a grill over an open fire to serve up a variety of dishes, including whole smoked chicken and fish, roasted cauliflower, a sweet and tangy grilled pineapple s’more dessert.

programme.title: Yakitori and More-Y
programme.desc: Don’t sleep on grilled chicken, especially if it’s Chef Dale night to cook! He’s serving up Japanese style yakitori three ways, from spicy to sweet to zesty, with crispy rice, and of course he adds his own flair to these delicious skewered snacks.

programme.title: Wok Cooking On A Charcoal Grill
programme.desc: Anything is possible with a wok and a good ol’ charcoal grill, at least if you’re Chef Dale, who throws together a heavenly spread of fiery eats, from drunken meats, stir fried veggies, and stir fried noodles.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They’re pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: Why LA’s "Danger Dog" is the Best Thing You’ll Ever Eat
